commands:
printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-buffered: started on <fq-hostname>
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
The jail o-a-sendmail-buffered has been started successfully.\n
Output will be buffered until 5 lines are available.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"

if [ -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt ]; then
printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-buffered: summary from <fq-hostname>
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
These hosts have been banned by Fail2Ban.\n
`cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt`
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"
rm /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt
fi
printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-buffered: stopped  on <fq-hostname>
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
The jail o-a-sendmail-buffered has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"

printf %b "`date`: <ip> (<failures> failures)\n" >> /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt
LINE=$( wc -l /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt | awk '{ print $1 }' )
if [ $LINE -ge 5 ]; then
printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-buffered: summary from <fq-hostname>
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
These hosts have been banned by Fail2Ban.\n
`cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt`
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"
rm /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mail.txt
fi

files.jail.local:
[o-a-sendmail-buffered]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = sendmail-buffered

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-sendmail-buffered
